compendium.summary: An invisible watchdog and non-concentration close-range hazard. Its main advantages are duration and guarding; a kill-box plan needs a separate containment method.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: A bite attempts 4d8 Force damage against an enemy within 5 feet at the start of your turn, with a Dexterity save. The hound is invulnerable but cannot pursue freely; moving it uses your Magic action.
Keep within 300 feet, choose a password and account for its audible alarm. In a force-prison plan, place the hound before sealing the target and agree on barrier geometry.
